protocol.fitting: separate sport and market; earlier data only; never refit registered weights
protocol.unit: one paired primary line per event/player/market; correlations clustered by event and date
protocol.missing_references: save observation; decision can qualify at a later observation
protocol.missing_model: save first eligible consensus decision with unavailable model; never backfill
protocol.execution: manual, public feed, and actual wagers remain separate

market.consensus: equal operator weight in log-odds; excludes FanDuel; exact half-lines only
market.primary_line: closest FanDuel no-vig probability to one half, then absolute line, then line
market.selection: one first paired offer per sport/event/player/market; evaluate both offered sides
